description_zh: 提交视频生成任务接口
kebab_example: aliyun yike submit-video-generation-job --client-token 00003e761e9d11edba640c42a1b70000 --job-type text_to_video --model happyhorse-1.1 --scene general --input 'Prompt_:_图1在篮球场上，用图2来了个灌篮_,_Medias_:_Type_:_image_,_Url_:_https://xxx/xxx.jpg_,_Type_:_image_,_Url_:_https://xxx/xxx.jpg' --job-parameters example-string --resolution 720P --aspect-ratio 9:16 --duration 5 --n 1 --user-data env_:_prd --api-version 2026-03-19 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitVideoGenerationJob

parameters.help_en:
The task type. Valid values:

text_to_video: text-to-video
image_to_video: image-to-video
first_last_frame: first and last frame to video
reference_to_video: reference to video
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，枚举值：
text_to_video ，文生视频
image_to_video ，图生视频
first_last_frame ，首尾帧生视频
reference_to_video，参考生视频
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en:
The model name. Valid values:

happyhorse-1.1
happyhorse-1.0
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: The scene type. Currently only `general` is supported
parameters.help_zh: 场景类型，枚举类型，当前仅有 `general`
parameters.name: scene

parameters.example: {"Prompt":"图1在篮球场上，用图2来了个灌篮","Medias":[{"Type":"image","Url":"https://xxx/xxx.jpg"},{"Type":"image","Url":"https://xxx/xxx.jpg"}]}
parameters.help_en:
The task input in JSON string format. The following fields are included:

Prompt: String. Required. The prompt text.
Medias: The media list.
When JobType is image_to_video, this field is required. Only 1 Media item is needed.
When JobType is first_last_frame, this field is required. Only 2 Media items are needed.
When JobType is reference_to_video, this field is required. A maximum of 9 Media items are supported.
The Media structure contains: Type, the media type, String, valid values are `image`/`video`/`audio`. URL, the media download URL, String
parameters.help_zh:
任务输入，Json String，包含：
Prompt，String，必填，提示词
Medias，媒体列表
当JobType=image_to_video 时，必填，Media仅需要1个
当JobType=first_last_frame 时，必填，Media仅需要2个
当JobType=reference_to_video 时，必填，Media最多9个
Media 结构包含：Type，媒体类型，String，可选值有`image`/`video`/`audio`；URL，媒体下载地址，String；
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The task feature parameters. No configuration is required at this time
parameters.help_zh: 任务功能参数，暂不需要设置
parameters.name: job_parameters

parameters.help_en: The aspect ratio. Valid values: 16:9 (default), 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, and 1:1
parameters.name: aspect_ratio

parameters.help_en: The output duration. Valid values: 4 to 15 seconds. Default value: 5s
parameters.help_zh: 输出时长，取值范围：4～15s，默认 5s
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: The number of outputs. Valid values: 1 to 4. Default value: 1
parameters.name: n

parameters.help_en: The user business data in JSON format
parameters.name: user_data
